newsitem.title: USA: Cobb County, Ga., approves hockey arena - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cobb County, Ga., approves hockey arena - paper.

text.p: Georgia's Cobb County Commission and Cobb-Marietta Coliseum and Exhibit Hall Authority approved the purchase of land for a professional hockey arena, the Atlanta Journal and Constitution said Wednesday.
The commission and the authority approved the $16 million purchase on Tuesday as part of a plan to attract a National Hockey League team.
The plan calls for building a $150 million, 20,000-seat arena on the land in the Galleria Centre area if the city attracts an expansion team or persuades one to relocate.

Cobb County Commission Chairman Bill Byrne told the newspaper that if the city does not lure a hockey team, the valuable 11.3 acre parcel of land could be used for a performing arts center or amphitheater, or sold at a profit.
